# importing libraries
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(plotly)
library(ggiraph)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(ggmap)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggridges)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(GGally)
```


# load data
```{r}
data<-read.csv("GSSsubset.csv")
head(data)
```


# ggplot with custom themes and colour  scales


```{r}
p<-ggplot(mtcars, aes(
  x=wt, y=mpg, color=factor(cyl)
))+
  geom_point(size=3)+
  
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1")+
  
  theme_bw(base_size=10)+
  labs(title="MPG Vs Weight by clinder",
       x="weight",
   
           y="cylinders")

p
```




# faceting  and multi-panel plot
```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=wt, y= mpg))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~cyl)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title=" Faceted plot by cylinder count")

```


 
# facet grid by cylinder and gears
```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=wt, y= mpg))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_grid(gear~cyl)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title=" Faceted plot by cylinder count and gear")

```





# scatter plot + regression line
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x=age, y=income))+
  geom_point(size=3)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE)+

  labs(title=" relationship between age and income",
       x="age",
       y="income"
       )+
  theme_minimal()
```



## interactive scatter plot
```{r}
p<-ggplot(
  data, aes(
    x=age,
    y=income,
    text=paste(
      "sex:", sex,
      "<br>degree:", degree,
      "<br>income:", income,
      "<br>age:", age
    )
  )
)+
  geom_point(size=3)+
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(p, tooltip="text")
p
```


# violin plot
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(
  x=degree, y=income, fill=degree
))+
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1, fill="white")+
  labs(
    title="income distribution by education level",
    x="education level",
    y="income"
  )+
  theme_minimal()
theme(legend.position="none")
```





# correlation heatmap
```{r}
numeric_data<- data[, c(
  "income",
  "age",
  "height",
  "weight",
  "hrswrk"
)]

cor_matrix<-cor(numeric_data)
corrplot(cor_matrix,
         method="color",
         type="upper",
         addCoef.col="black",
         tl.col="black",
         tl.srt=45)
```




# pairplot
```{r}
ggpairs(
  data[, c(
     "income",
  "age",
  "height",
  "weight",
  "hrswrk"
  )]
)
```




# pie chart count gender
```{r}
set_data<-data %>% 
  count(sex) %>% 
  mutate(
    percentage=n/sum(n)*100,
    label=paste0(round(percentage, 1),"%")
  )
# create a pie chart

ggplot(set_data, aes(x="", y=n, fill=sex))+
  geom_col(width=1)+
  coord_polar(theta="y")+
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label=label
    ),
    position=position_stack(vjust=0.5),
    size=5
  )+
  labs(
    title=" distribution of respondents by Gender",
    fill="Gender"
  )+
  theme_void()
```



# bubble chart
```{r}
ggplot(
  data, aes(
    x=age,
    y=income,
    size=hrswrk,
    color=sex
  )
)+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5)+
  labs(
    title="Age income and working hrs",
    x= "age",
    y="income",
    size="working hours",
    color="sex"
  )+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20)
```



## 3D scatter plot
```{r}
fig<- plot_ly(
  data,
    x=~age, 
    y=~income,
    z=~weight,
    color=~sex,
    trpe="scatter3d",
    mode="markers",
    marker=list(size=6)
  )
  
  fig<-fig %>% 
    layout(
      title="3D relationship btn Age, income an d weight",
      scene= list(
        xaxis=list(title="Age"),
        yaxis=list(title="Income"),
        zaxis=list(title="weight")
      ))
    fig
```





# ridge line/ distribution plot
```{r}
ggplot(
  data, 
  aes(
    x=income,
    y=degree,
    fill=degree
  )
)+
  geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.7, bandwidth=7430)+
  labs(
    title=" income distribution accross education levels",
    x="income",
    y=" Education Level"
  )+
  theme_minimal()
theme(legend.position="none")
```




```{r}
ggplot(
  data,

)+

  )+

theme(legend.position="none")
```
